https.cookie: Signed in, but this browser didn't keep the session. Open Promus over HTTPS.
https.how: Signing in and offline use only work over HTTPS. Put HTTPS in front of the server, for example with a reverse proxy, and open its https:// address.

install.ios: To install: in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Then open Promus from the Home Screen and sign in again: the installed app keeps its own sign-in, apart from Safari's.
install.other: To install: open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

invite.intro: Whoever opens this link can join your household and share its lists. It works once, for 7 days.
invite.title: Invite someone

join.intro: You've been invited to share a household's lists. Choose a username and password.
join.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
join.title: Join a household

list.emptyHint: Add the first item with Add or find below.

login.pendingOtherUser: Sync or sign in as {{username}} first
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later

phone.local: This is the server's own address, which your phone can't open. On your phone, use the server's https:// address.
phone.scan: Scan with your phone's camera to open Promus there.
phone.title: Open on your phone
